task: Generate the canonical personal-stylist verdict from this reviewed profile.

final_summary.next_best_action: Provide the high-priority style intake plus controlled daylight and full-body fit photos before selecting a professional wardrobe direction.
largest_uncertainties: Skin undertone and a definitive personal color palette cannot be established from this single uncalibrated image.
Facial-hair coverage limits precision around the jaw and chin.
No responsible conclusions can be made about body proportions, posture, lower-body fit, or complete outfit silhouette.
Professional needs, taste, budget, comfort, and fit preferences are not yet known.
final_summary.provisional_style_profile: A clean, understated casual presentation with a strong grooming baseline. Initial face-led testing can focus on controlled texture in the haircut, intentional stubble edge maintenance, and deeper muted colors, while all broader wardrobe recommendations await lifestyle and full-body fit evidence.
strongest_supported_observations: Clear front-facing portrait with soft, even lighting and limited visible lens distortion.
Face appears moderately longer than wide, with a preliminary oval-oblong reading and a subtle rectangular influence.
Hair is dark brown, short tapered at the sides, and styled with a longer textured top; visible grooming is clean and cohesive.
Short, fairly even stubble beard and moustache are visible.
The only visible garment is a black or near-black casual crew-neck T-shirt.

analysis_status.summary: A clear, front-facing head-and-upper-shoulders portrait supports a preliminary assessment of face geometry, visible grooming, and recorded coloring. It does not support body-proportion or lower-body analysis.

follow_up_questions.question: Why are you refining your style now, and what three words should your professional appearance communicate?
follow_up_questions.why_needed: Sets the image target before translating visual observations into wardrobe choices.

follow_up_questions.question: Who are your most important professional audiences, and what settings matter most (for example office, client meetings, presentations, networking, creative work, travel)?
follow_up_questions.why_needed: Professional formality and credibility signals must fit the actual audience.

follow_up_questions.question: What do you wear in a typical week, including required dress codes and how often you need business formal, business casual, smart casual, or casual clothing?
follow_up_questions.why_needed: Determines the wardrobe mix and priority purchases.

follow_up_questions.question: List two outfits you feel best in, two you avoid, and any saved style references; say what you like or dislike about each.
follow_up_questions.why_needed: Reveals taste and avoids imposing a generic style direction.

follow_up_questions.question: What fit problems recur in shirts, jackets, trousers, and shoes, and do you prefer trim, regular, relaxed, or mixed ease?
follow_up_questions.why_needed: Needed to distinguish desired ease from actual fit issues.

follow_up_questions.question: Do you have fabric sensitivities, heat/cold concerns, mobility needs, or footwear comfort requirements?
follow_up_questions.why_needed: Ensures recommendations are wearable in practice.

follow_up_questions.question: What is your total starting budget and your approximate ceiling for a shirt, trousers, shoes, jacket, and suit?
follow_up_questions.why_needed: Determines viable quality, tailoring, and shopping strategies.

follow_up_questions.question: What is your tolerance for ironing, dry-cleaning, tailoring, and garment care?

requested_additional_photos.purpose: Improves confidence in recorded coloring and color-direction testing.
requested_additional_photos.instructions: Take one unfiltered front-facing photo near a north-facing window or in open shade, without strong colored surroundings; include the face, neck, and a plain white/grey reference if available.

requested_additional_photos.photo: Full-body front, side, and back fit photos
requested_additional_photos.purpose: Enables responsible assessment of visual proportions, posture, silhouette, and trouser/jacket fit.
requested_additional_photos.instructions: Use a level camera at mid-torso height, step back to avoid wide-angle distortion, wear a fitted T-shirt or shirt and well-fitting trousers, keep a natural stance, and include footwear.

requested_additional_photos.purpose: Identifies practical fit issues and builds recommendations around the real wardrobe.
requested_additional_photos.instructions: Provide front and side views of 1–3 outfits you actually wear for work, ideally including jacket or overshirt, trousers, and shoes where relevant.

requested_additional_photos.purpose: Refines haircut shape and beard-line recommendations.
requested_additional_photos.instructions: Take relaxed left and right three-quarter or side views in the same neutral light, with hair styled as usual.
